subject: Mathematics
title: Thithiri and Friends
subtitle: Where is Thithiri? Counting 1 to 5
hero_picture: A Kerala village courtyard: a girl (Ima) and a boy (Amal) gently holding a tiny brown baby bird, a cow with a calf, cats, puppies, hens with chicks and a duck with ducklings around them.

sections.heading: A little bird
text: Ima and Amal found a little bird.
They kept her safe from crows and cats.
sections.caption: Ima, Amal and Thithiri
sections.picture: A girl and a boy kneeling on the ground looking at a tiny brown baby bird that fell from a tree; crows on a branch above.

sections.heading: Where is Thithiri?
text: Not on the almirah. Not under the bed.
Not in front of the sofa. Not behind it.
Here she is, inside the dollhouse!
sections.caption: Looking for Thithiri
sections.picture: Inside a house: a boy searching under a bed, a girl looking behind a sofa, and a tiny bird peeping out from inside a colourful dollhouse.

sections.heading: Are you my mom?
text: The cow has 1 kid. The cat has 2.
The hen has 4 chicks. The dog has 5 puppies.
None of them looks like Thithiri.
sections.caption: Counting the babies
sections.picture: Animals with their babies in a row, clearly countable: 1 cow with 1 calf, 1 cat with 2 kittens, 1 hen with 4 chicks, 1 dog with 5 puppies.

sections.heading: 2 and 3 make 5
sections.caption: Mother duck and ducklings
sections.picture: A mother duck walking with 5 little yellow ducklings: 2 ducklings in front of her and 3 ducklings behind her, on green grass with flowers.

sections.heading: Here's your mom!
text: They heard a bird crying in the garden.
Now Thithiri is happy with her mom.
sections.caption: Thithiri finds her mother
sections.picture: Children happily reuniting a tiny baby bird with its mother bird on a tree branch in a garden, all smiling.

activity: Count the spoons in your kitchen and the chairs in your house. Write the numbers.
talk: How many puppies did the dog have?
summary: We can count from 1 to 5 and tell where things are: on, under, in front, behind, inside.

questions.prompt: What was the little bird's name?
questions.explanation: Ima and Amal named the bird Thithiri.

questions.prompt: How many kittens did the cat have?
questions.explanation: The cat said, 'I have two kids.'

questions.prompt: 2 ducklings in front and 3 behind. How many in all?
